White Mage: A healer and protector who restores HP, cures ailments and revives allies.
Black Mage: An offensive caster focused on elemental damage, destructive magic and powerful spells.
Red Mage: A versatile caster combining healing, elemental spells and status magic.
Blue Mage: Uses Enemy Skill to learn monster techniques, including unusual attacks, healing and utility.
Time Mage: Controls battle tempo and gravity, with space-themed magic and travel utility.
Summoner: Calls creatures for damage, support and revival. Specializes in Summon Materia and W-Summon.
Mystic Knight: Combines magic with physical combat. Links elemental and status effects to weapon or armor slots.
Monk: A martial fighter focused on powerful physical strikes, counterattacks and endurance.
Gambler: A luck-and-rewards specialist represented by Luck Plus and Gil Plus.
Ranger: A ranged scout using distance, awareness and pre-emptive attacks.
Gunner: A ranged attacker focused on reach, sweeping attacks, enemy analysis and experience rewards.
Beastmaster: Controls enemies with Manipulate and influences encounters with lure Materia.
Scholar: An enemy analyst whose current Materia specialty is Sense.
Mime: Repeats allies' actions and gains broad command access through Master Command.
Chemist / Alchemist: An item specialist using W-Item and Morph for supplies and battlefield utility.
Mystic / Oracle: Disrupts enemies with Mystify and supports status-magic strategies.
Sage: A master caster with the full Magic Materia catalogue and advanced casting support.
Knight: Protects allies with Cover and reinforces survival with HP Plus.
Paladin: A protective fighter blending Cover and endurance with healing and defensive magic.
Warrior: A physical attacker using strong strikes, multi-hit attacks and extra HP.
Samurai: A precise fighter focused on Deathblow, Double Cut and Slash-All.
Thief: Steals items, strikes opportunistically and improves speed, luck and gil rewards.
Ninja: A fast attacker using Throw, Double Cut, Poison and surprise-oriented support.
Dragoon: A fighter represented here by long reach, HP and MP absorption, and endurance.
Dark Knight: A dark fighter combining Destruct with HP and MP absorption and extra HP.
